query:
UPDATE crawl_page
            SET work_state = 'done',
                status = CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 'failed'
            ELSE status END, error = CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN
                '已取消，页面资料尚未整理完成' ELSE error END
            WHERE crawl_id = ? AND work_state != 'done'
